correctness.rationale: The exact identities A^3−C^2=108B^4 and 481^3−(−4879)^2=108(30)^4 yield R=G_-G_+ over Q(sqrt(481)); independently expanded using symbolic rational polynomial arithmetic. In K=C(v), w²=A is genus-three hyperelliptic with eight simple branch roots. Each q=t⁴ quadratic factor has discriminant a nonzero scalar times A³ and thus field K(w). Its distinguished q is a constant multiple of C±Aw; if it were a square, C±6√(−3)B²=(v⁴±2√(−3)v²+1)³ would have to be a square in C(v), impossible because the quartic has simple roots. It follows that t⁴=q is degree four over K(w), so both octic factors are absolutely irreducible. At five zeros of B the divisor of C+Aw has multiplicity four; infinity poles have orders 12,8, giving no non-four-divisible valuations and an étale connected cyclic four-cover with g=9 by Riemann−Hurwitz. Allocation of 32 cusps each and 96 intersection nodes uses Burek Lemma 8.2 as an explicitly cited external geometric premise; this global boundary assertion was not independently reconstructed from the source in this run, so genus and local divisor claims are conditional on its correctness.
